dataset: Niedźwiecka, A., Pisula, E., Domasiewicz, Z. (2020). Q-CHAT scores of Polish toddlers with autism spectrum disorders and typically developing controls. Mendeley Data, V2. doi:10.17632/tmpkt2mfkg.2 (CC BY 4.0)

count_discrepancy.resolution: the file has 252 rows = 135 ASD + 117 controls; the '118' on the page is inconsistent with its own total of 252

response_scale: integers 0-4 per item, higher = more atypical (already direction-recoded by the authors; `*recode` columns)
out_of_range_handling: values outside 0-4 are set to missing; none of the ten mapped items is affected

mapping_verification.note: label 'niemożliwe' (impossible) is attached to value 5 in the file; 5 never occurs; read as 4 (scale maximum)

mapping_source: Allison, Auyeung & Baron-Cohen 2012 JAACAP 51(2):202-212, Table 3 (Q-CHAT-10 = Q-CHAT items 1,2,5,6,9,10,15,17,19,25); wording/scoring: ARC Q-CHAT-10 form

label_provenance.dataset_page_statement: '135 with a community-based diagnosis of autism spectrum disorders (ASD) and ... typically developing toddlers'
label_provenance.documented_instruments: NOT stated on the dataset page. The related Polish Q-CHAT paper (Niedźwiecka & Pisula 2022, PMC8910243) studies a different 1,024-child sample whose 252 'ASD-concerns' children had no confirmed diagnosis and does not mention ADOS-2/ADI-R/DSM-5 for it; the dataset's own manuscript was 'under review' and could not be located.
label_provenance.assessment: Label is independent of the Q-CHAT (not derived from item totals) but its clinical rigor (ADOS-2/ADI-R/DSM-5) is NOT verified from the sources available here.
label_provenance.control_definition: typically developing; recruitment channel/screening of controls not documented

publication_check: Allison 2012 reports sensitivity 0.91 / specificity 0.89 at cut-point 3 (different samples)
sampling_limitations: case-control design: 53.6% ASD; prevalence in the intended population is far lower, so predicted probabilities are not population risk and PPV would be much lower
recruitment source almost determines the label (bdbp# ids: 89 controls vs 2 ASD; FS/# ids: 80 ASD vs 12 controls): collection context is confounded with diagnosis
Polish translation of the Q-CHAT, completed by caregivers in Poland; not validated for English-language or other populations
ages 18-24 months only; sex imbalance (ASD 71% male, controls 52% male)
ASD labels described as 'community-based diagnosis'; instruments used are not documented on the dataset page
sibling_withASD is missing/0 for every control (structural), so it must never be a predictor
